task: Cloth new2 h168 standalone RGB to gaze

augmentation: flip p=.5; brightness .6-1.4; channel .85-1.15; blur sigma .5-2 p=.4

reset_method: Current native circular mean/std q4:26, zero wheels; arithmetic mean/std hands;55train row0 only
